description: This file defines an interface for a grain in an Orleans-based distributed system, specifying asynchronous methods for stream subscription, object property management, and identification.

classes.name: IStreamingImmutabilityTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for testing streaming immutability, including methods for subscribing/unsubscribing to streams, setting, getting test object properties, and retrieving silo identifier.

methods.name: SubscribeToStream
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a specific stream identified by a GUID and provider name.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromStream
methods.description: Unsubscribes the grain from the current stream.

methods.name: SendTestObject
methods.description: Sends a test object to the stream identified by the provider name.

methods.name: SetTestObjectStringProperty
methods.description: Sets the string property of the test object.

methods.name: GetTestObjectStringProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the string property of the test object.

methods.name: GetSiloIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the silo hosting the grain.
